suggestions.title: Make one requirement register the source of truth
options: A. Keep research/nfl-decision-readiness.json (70 rows) and retire the other three registers into a crosswalk.
B. Keep all four and generate a crosswalk page (no status edits).
C. Defer until the owner decides.
suggestions.desk_recommendation: A, after the owner confirms which rows are current.
suggestions.acceptance: One register feeds the landing page; a test fails if another register disagrees.

suggestions.title: Decide the terms route for any capture
options: A. Send a written consent request to the NFL Legal address named in the terms; no capture until a written answer exists.
B. Use a licensed data feed from a rights-holder instead of nfl.com.
C. Stop automated capture; use only the dated captures already held.
suggestions.desk_recommendation: A and B in parallel; C until one of them answers.
suggestions.acceptance: A recorded written answer, or a signed licence, with date and scope.

suggestions.title: Choose the depth-order route for all 32 clubs
options: A. Keep Houston out of the depth model; use club charts for 31 clubs (current state).
B. Obtain an official snap-count arrangement (Q3) and join it.
C. Freeze depth features until one route covers 32 clubs.
suggestions.desk_recommendation: C until Q3 or Q8 is answered.
suggestions.acceptance: One route verified club by club for all 32 clubs.

suggestions.title: Recount Week 10 injuries once, with clock times and hashes
options: A. One complete read of the official report, all chunks, timestamped and hashed; reconcile the three captures.
B. Retire the 254/279 targets from the requirement text.
C. Quote no Week 10 total until A is done.
suggestions.acceptance: A row-level reconciliation table with zero unexplained differences.

suggestions.title: Pick the canonical results file
options: A. Adopt the 150-row file after a row-level diff against the official pages.
B. Keep the 149-row file and add LAC@BAL as a pending row.
suggestions.acceptance: One file cited by every desk; the other file removed or marked superseded.

suggestions.title: Implement or relabel the random-pick control
options: A. Score a seeded random-pick strategy in the same run as the favourite control.
B. Relabel the random-sign test as a null test and drop the 'random picks' requirement wording.
suggestions.desk_recommendation: A, because the requirement asks for it by name.
suggestions.acceptance: A published random-pick row with its n and seed.

suggestions.title: Verify the rulebook body before using rule elements
options: A. Read sections 6-1-2 and 6-1-6 of the 2026 rulebook in full; correct rules-2026.html from them.
B. Keep rules-2026.html limited to the change table.
suggestions.desk_recommendation: A before any priors filter is applied.
suggestions.acceptance: Each element value cites a rulebook sentence read in full.
